stages.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone formation marker sprite for a top-down RTS, one icon only, transparent PNG.
Reference image in conversation: style reference only. Match its very simple, bold tactical token language: saturated royal blue, medium gray, crisp white.
Design a flat 2D, vector-like game marker viewed straight-on so the game can rotate it. Rectangle outer dimensions approximately 2:1, centered horizontally on a square canvas with ample transparent margins. Thick straight royal-blue border (#2422E8), sharp square corners, no rounded corners. Inside is divided diagonally from bottom-left to top-right into a royal-blue upper-left triangle and medium-gray (#808080) lower-right triangle, separated by a narrow crisp white diagonal stroke. A small white forward-pointing triangle is centered in the upper border. Center the requested large white pictogram inside the panel; use a restrained dark-blue edge only if needed for readability against the white divider. Extremely simple low-detail silhouettes, legible at 48 pixels, consistent heavy visual weight. Keep all elements inside the border.
Palette only royal blue, gray, white and minimal dark blue. Absolutely no health bar, status bar, terrain, green, cyan, yellow, text, letters, numbers, labels, watermark, decorative insignia, lighting gradient, texture, bevel, perspective, extruded sides, baked shadow, extra icons or second panel. Genuine alpha transparency outside the marker, never a checkerboard painted into the image.
SUBJECT:
ONE melee infantry formation icon. The white pictogram is two crossed simple medieval swords, broad blades and short crossguards. No bow, no horse. The diagonal background and facing triangle follow the shared specification.

Create ONE new standalone icon by replacing the crossed sword pictogram with the requested subject. Completely remove both swords and their handles. Preserve the template's exact blue and gray diagonal background, white separator, blue border weight, facing triangle, crisp flat style, framing, colors and alpha transparency. Leave enough margin so nothing is cropped. No text, health bar, status bar, terrain, shadow or extra marker. All white silhouettes need the same restrained dark-blue outline as the template. Keep strong small-scale readability. Keep the rectangular frame exactly as the template.

Edit the input formation marker. Change ONLY its palette. Preserve exactly the unit pictogram identity and geometry, rectangle or circle shape, placement, facing marker, diagonal division, overall proportions, framing and alpha transparency.

Preserve the exact black crossed-sword pictogram, black facing arrow, pure-white field and frame, medium-gray lower-right triangular field and its thin white diagonal separator. Preserve proportions and centering. All colors neutral grayscale, no colored edges. Flat opaque colors inside the shape; genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside it. No extra outline or shadow. One clean, polished, crisp UI sprite.
